variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The colony has had an accident at a workplace.
variants.body:
An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}. The occurrence is established, while a particular injury or legal finding is not supplied here. Readers considering {target} should distinguish scrutiny of safety responsibility from an invented account of the accident's cause or the condition of those involved.

Our convictions require that the conditions of work be treated as a public concern. Safety should not depend on how convenient it is to discuss. A serious political judgment can insist on responsibility while refusing to turn the occurrence of an accident into proof of particulars that have not been reported.

We criticise {target} on the standard of safety stewardship. An accident warrants serious questions about responsibility, rather than a comfortable presumption that the conduct surrounding work should remain beyond public judgment. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.

variants.headline: Workplace safety becomes immediate news
variants.sub: A workplace in the colony has been the scene of an accident.
